\f[facebrock]Brock: I’ve seen what happens when chaos rules.\nI’m leaning toward the candidate who promises a secure and honest future for all of us.
\f[facemisty]Misty: \rRed told me everything about Giovanni.\nThat he's was the Leader of the Team Rocket 4 years ago.
\f[facemisty]\rAlmost nobody seems to believe him.\nThey say he has no proof.
\f[facemisty]\rI can just hope that the correct decision is taken in the elections today...
Voting kiosks will stay open all day, but if you don’t show up by tonight, your chance is gone. No exceptions.
\f[faceErika]Erika:\r The harmony of nature and tradition must be preserved. I’m hopeful that our decision today will reflect the heart of Kanto.
\f[faceJanine]\rI hope that today’s decision brings balance. I trust that, whether through strength or wisdom, our path will be the right one for everyone.
Hey there! If you’re voting, go to the end of the line.
Ugh, why is this more stressful than a Gym Battle?
Alright… let’s hope I’m making the right choice.
Part of me wants to just leave… but this matters, so I need to decide carefully.
One vote won’t change much… or will it?
Everyone’s so tense… can’t blame them, though.
I heard Gym Leaders votes count more… kinda unfair, don’t you think?
My team’s ready for battles, not politics… but here we are.
\f[faceBlaine]Blaine: \bOrder is needed to restore what has been lost. Giovanni’s plan promises that stability.
\f[lance]Lance: \bToday’s vote isn’t just a formality, it’s a turning point.\nChoose wisely, our future depends on the balance between strength and compassion.
\f[faceKaren]Karen: \rWhat this region needs is someone who respects the soul of Pokémon, not just the power they can bring.\nI stand with those who fight for something deeper than control.
\f[facelt.surge]Lt. Surge: Discipline builds strength! I stand with Giovanni.\nHis leadership will secure our region’s future.
\f[faceSabrina]Sabrina: In times of uncertainty, a steady hand is essential. Giovanni’s resolve will lead us forward.
\f[faceWill]Will: \bKanto’s future depends on control - of emotions, of systems, of outcomes. We can't afford uncertainty in a world that demands order.

\f[faceBruno]Bruno: \bI’ve trained my whole life for clarity. In battle, in duty, in principle. When the world becomes uncertain, strong leadership keeps people moving forward.\nHard decision to make here today.
